verdict.rationale: Dover documents interview feedback forms that are assigned to a stage so every interviewer scores candidates the same way. That covers per-stage structure and consistent, comparable scoring. Interviewers with Job Basic access cannot see others' feedback, which keeps evaluations independent. missing for 10: evidence of defined scorecard attributes or rating scales within forms, per-interviewer focus areas or rubrics within a stage, a side-by-side candidate scorecard comparison view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates

citations.quote: Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
It shows the candidate's details, their resume, and the feedback form assigned to the interview stage.
A member with **Job Basic** can submit feedback, but can't see other interviewers' feedback
